<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>agentrs</id>
    <version>0.1.1</version>
    <title>agentrs</title>
    <authors>Sergio Ricardo de Sousa</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/sergio-r-sousa/agentrs.net</projectUrl>
    <description>.NET port of the Rust agentrs SDK with provider-agnostic LLM abstractions, tools, MCP, memory, multi-agent orchestration, YAML loading, and AgentTool source generation.</description>
    <tags>agentrs ai agents llm mcp openai anthropic gemini ollama multi-agent</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/sergio-r-sousa/agentrs.net" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="StackExchange.Redis" version="2.8.37" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="YamlDotNet" version="16.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
